# Open Design Vendor Slot

Card Condition Vault is designed to use `https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design` as the product and dogfood design harness.

Add it as a submodule when network access is available:

```bash
git submodule add https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design vendor/open-design
```

The MVP follows the Open Design discipline in `docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` and `docs/demo/OPEN_DESIGN_INTEGRATION.md`:

- Modern minimal + Tech utility base direction.
- Editorial condition report surfaces.
- Question-form first-run demo selection.
- P0/P1/P2 gates for each workflow.
- Honest placeholders and artifact lint before release.
